item.title: Can I favourite TV programmes?
item.description: Can I favourite TV programmes? The Freesat Mobile App james.allan Wed, 09/24/2025 - 15:10 You can’t set individual TV programmes as favourites, but you can mark your favourite channels.In the Freesat mobile app, double-tap or long press a channel icon in the What’s On section or in the TV Guide to add it to your favourites. item.description: Can I restart programmes that have already started? item.title: How do I access the TV Guide?
item.description: How do I access the TV Guide? The Freesat Mobile App robyn.ellis Wed, 09/24/2025 - 15:14 You’ll find the TV Guide in the centre of the menu at the bottom of the Freesat mobile app, it’s labelled Guide. Just tap it to open.To switch between what’s on now and the full guide, tap the triple bar icon in the top left corner. You can also view a single channel’s schedule by tapping its icon.Favourites and remindersTo add a channel to your favourites, double tap or long press its icon in the TV Guide.
